newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aussie Home Loans cuts fixed home mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: Aussie Home Loans cuts fixed home mortgage rates.

text.p: Australia's largest non-bank mortgage originator, Aussie Home Loans, cut its fixed mortgage interest rates on Wednesday, but they remain at or above the variable rates offered by Aussie and the major banks.
Aussie cut its one to five-year fixed mortgage rates by between 0.25 percent and 0.5 percent, with its one year rate cut to 6.99 percent from 7.49 percent.
It cut its five year rate to 8.5 percent from 8.75 percent.
Aussie cut its variable mortgage rate by 0.5 percent to 6.99 percent on May 23 after the Reserve Bank of Australia's surprise cut in official rates to 5.5 percent from 6.0 percent.
